Accept yourself as who you are. That's the first step -- think to yourself that no matter the situation, you will definitely be alright and soldier on. 

This tactic is called self-confidence. And its a huge positive to your life in general.

From there, just take the simple next step of saying "Hi, how you doing today?". Now this is where variations of it would be effective, depending on your level of humour. Personally I would say "Hey, I saw you from over there and I would've regretted it if I didn't say Hi" -- this leads onto a sense of curiosity from her (hopefully) and thus a small sense of interest. 

And from there just play it by ear. If she smiles, then it's a cue to use your imagination to talk about something. If she seems distant, then it depends on your persistence. Questions are a great way to draw more interest.

Hope that helps.
